production.note: US model years 2015-2020. A small 2015 model-year run came first: 'Just 137 examples bearing a 2015 VIN will be built', 100 GT350 and 37 GT350R, before production switched to 2016 models (Motor Authority, 28 April 2015). End: Ford announced on 1 October 2020 that the GT350 and GT350R 'will be phased out after 2020', with production ceasing that fall (source motorauthority-gt350-end-2020).

body.note: Ford spec sheet: body style Fastback. No convertible. The GT350R is a separate variant.

aspiration.note: Described as naturally aspirated in source motorauthority-gt350-end-2020.

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel drive with Torsen limited-slip differential

transmission.note: Tremec TR-3160 six-speed manual, the only transmission. Unchanged to the end of the run (source motorauthority-gt350-end-2020).

powerHp.note: Ford 2016 technical specifications. Quote: "Horsepower 526 @ 7,500 rpm". Torque 429 lb.-ft. @ 4,750 rpm. The rating did not change through 2020 (source motorauthority-gt350-end-2020: 'a naturally aspirated V-8 with 526 horsepower and 429 pound-feet of torque').

weightLb.note: Ford 2016 technical specifications, standard GT350 (six-speed manual, no packages). Quote: "Curb weight 3,760 lbs." The same sheet lists GT350 with Track Package at 3,791 lb and the GT350R at 3,655 lb; neither is used.
